summary: Learn to assess media, track custody, and document disposal evidence. Explore the five-day secure information disposal course.
lede: Secure information disposal is the controlled removal of information from media and services at end of use, with treatment, custody and proof recorded. For information security officers, IT asset managers and records professionals, this course develops practical skills to assess asset records and choose media treatments, manage custody and backup or retention exceptions, and review vendor evidence to document closure.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who approve, carry out, monitor, or audit the retirement of information-bearing assets and services.
modules: Chain of Custody and Vendor Evidence
prerequisites: Prior familiarity with information asset records, IT asset handling, information security, or records retention is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Spreadsheet access is useful for register and reporting exercises.
